rows.behavior: kmctl briefing prints routing, state and the knowledge rules in a repository with docs/ and .okf/.
rows.fails_when: any of the three parts is missing from the output

rows.behavior: State shows counts only: concepts due, live handoffs, and the newest handoff's title.
rows.fails_when: the state part lists concept names, or a count disagrees with review due or kmctl handoffs on the fixture
len(output.split()) exceeds 600 on the fixture with due concepts and handoffs

rows.behavior: In a repository with no .okf/ the briefing says how to start one and exits 0.
rows.fails_when: it exits nonzero, or does not name kmctl init

rows.behavior: The briefing reads and never writes.
rows.fails_when: any file in the fixture repository changes after a run

rows.behavior: --json prints the same content as one object.
rows.fails_when: stdout is not one JSON object with routing, state and rules
